claims.text: For \(p_a(t)=[z^t]\prod_{k=1}^a(1-z^k)^{-1}\), with \(p_a(t)=0\) for \(t<0\), \[ \#\{\rho\subseteq b^a:|\rho|=N\} =\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,a\}}(-1)^{|S|} p_a\!\left(N-|S|b-\sum_{s\in S}s\right). \]

Conditional on the accepted graded integral basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho\), \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), \[ \operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N} =\sum_{S\subseteq[a]}(-1)^{|S|} p_a\!\left(N-|S|b-\sum_{s\in S}s\right), \] and \(Q_{ij+N}\) is free abelian, vanishing unless \(0\le N\le ab\).
